business_rules: Match Score Calculation Criteria: The system SHALL use a scoring algorithm to calculate a match score minimally based on skill overlap, education match, training match, location match, experience range, and salary expectation range.
Minimum Match Threshold: The system SHALL allow administrators to define and adjust a minimum match threshold (e.g., 60%) that determines which job matches are displayed to users.
Two-Way Matching: The system SHALL support two-way matching, where job seekers receive ranked job opportunities and employers receive reverse matches with ranked lists of suitable job seekers.
Automatic Candidate Filtering: The system SHALL allow employers to set minimum qualification thresholds for automatic candidate filtering.

findings.rationale: JobApplication represents a core transactional entity with its own lifecycle (submitted, reviewed, etc.) and should be an aggregate root within JobManagement. Currently, it is not part of any aggregate.
findings.proposed_revision: Create a JobApplication aggregate containing the JobApplication entity.

findings.rationale: AnalyticsAndReporting contains AnalyticsReport and AnalyticsReportTemplate, which exactly duplicate CustomReport and ReportTemplate in PlatformOperations. Reporting capabilities are split across two contexts unnecessarily.
findings.proposed_revision: Consolidate all reporting and template management into AnalyticsAndReporting and remove the duplicate entities from PlatformOperations.

findings.rationale: ExternalJobSite in ProfileManagement and PartnerPlatform in PartnerIntegration represent the same domain concept (third-party job portals). This creates duplication and fragmented truth across contexts.
findings.proposed_revision: Consolidate the management of external job sites into PartnerIntegration or keep the profile in ProfileManagement and reference it by ID in PartnerIntegration, ensuring clear boundaries.

findings.rationale: According to the requirements, the extracted information from a parsed resume is added to the job seeker's profile. While the AI engine performs the parsing, the resulting structured resume data belongs in ProfileManagement as part of the profile, not as a standalone entity in the matching context.
findings.proposed_revision: Move ParsedResume (or its extracted data representation) to ProfileManagement and associate it with the JobSeekerProfile aggregate.

findings.rationale: AnalyticsAndReporting needs to track matching algorithm performance metrics (accuracy, precision, recall), which requires consuming data or events from MatchingAndRecommendation.
findings.proposed_revision: Add a CUSTOMER_SUPPLIER or PUBLISHED_LANGUAGE relationship from MatchingAndRecommendation (upstream) to AnalyticsAndReporting (downstream).

findings.rationale: GovernmentDatabase represents an external system rather than a domain entity with behavior and state within the platform. It lacks an aggregate and does not fit the definition of an entity.
findings.proposed_revision: Remove GovernmentDatabase as an entity, or model the specific integration configuration/adapter as a Value Object or Entity within an aggregate.

findings.rationale: JobCategory is likely a reference data concept (managed by Taxonomy in PlatformOperations) rather than a full entity with lifecycle behavior in JobManagement.
findings.proposed_revision: Convert JobCategory to a Value Object within the JobPosting aggregate, referencing the central Taxonomy ID.

relationships.rationale: ProfileManagement relies on IdentityAndAccess for user authentication, account activation, and role-based access control.
PlatformOperations manages system taxonomies (skills, occupations) which serve as a published language for standardizing job postings in JobManagement.
ProfileManagement uses the taxonomies (skills, education) managed by PlatformOperations as a published language to standardize job seeker profiles.
JobManagement requires employer profiles to create job postings and job seeker profiles to manage applications.
The AI matching engine requires job posting data to calculate match scores and generate recommendations.
The matching engine needs job seeker profiles (skills, education, experience) to match them against job postings.
JobManagement exposes APIs for job data synchronization, which PartnerIntegration consumes to push standardized job postings from external sources.
AnalyticsAndReporting consumes job posting and application data to generate employment statistics and labor market insights.
AnalyticsAndReporting uses user registration and profile data to generate demographic and geographic distribution reports.
PlatformOperations tracks user activities and system performance metrics, which are consumed by AnalyticsAndReporting for dashboards and reports.
